verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents sending a campaign via the Marketing API (immediate send, with RSS campaigns following their schedule) and audiences as a core resource. Its email-design positioning plus a hands-on account of the drag-and-drop builder corroborate composing. One user's report of the editor failing to load on a single day is an isolated incident, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduling regular campaigns for a chosen date/time, explicit evidence of selecting or segmenting the target audience when building a campaign, and in-depth first-party docs of the end-to-end compose workflow.
